tape_v20_cha22 third-party notice
===================================

This agent runs the agent code of the public Kaggle notebook

    abhinav0370/cha22-agent
    https://www.kaggle.com/code/abhinav0370/cha22-agent

vendored here as `policy.py`.  The notebook ships the Apache License 2.0 in its own
payload and states no other licence; Kaggle's public-notebook default is also Apache 2.0.  The
licence text is reproduced here as LICENSE.txt and remains inline in `policy.py` as the notebook
shipped it.  The notebook credits thomastschinkel, yhay81, destbreso, aurax7, tetsutani, prvsiyan, Dmitrii Gluzdov, Ahmed Berat Ozer for the upstream routing and action data, likewise
Apache 2.0.

`main.py` is our wrapper (`submission/wrap_main.py`): it loads `policy.py` once, calls its entry
point once per turn and never resets its per-seat state, and applies a table of deterministic
market-row overrides from `overrides.json` to the turn the policy emitted.  The entry point is
the one Kaggle itself would run, the last callable in `policy.py`'s namespace, so the wrapped
bundle plays exactly what the notebook plays.  Everything the base policy returns that no
override names is passed through untouched.
